quotations.old_english: Hé lǽdde his hálgan béc mid him on fellenum saccum (sæccum, v. l.)
quotations.latin: sacros codices in pelliceis sacculis portabat

source_text: sacc. Add :-- Hé lǽdde his hálgan béc mid him on fellenum saccum (sæccum, v. l.) sacros codices in pelliceis sacculis portabat, Gr. D. 34, 15. [From Latin saccus.]
